title: Output Parsers
summary: This module provides various output parsers to structure language model responses into specific formats like lists, XML, JSON, or Pydantic objects, and includes mechanisms for error handling and retries.

nodes.label: BaseOutputParser
nodes.title: Base Output Parser
nodes.description: The foundational class for all output parsers, defining the interface for parsing language model outputs into structured formats.

nodes.label: BaseGenerationOutputParser
nodes.title: Base Generation Output Parser
nodes.description: A base class for parsing language model generations, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous parsing of results.

nodes.label: List Output Parsers
nodes.title: List Output Parsers
nodes.description: Parsers designed to extract and format lists from raw text, including comma-separated, numbered, and Markdown lists.

nodes.label: Transform Output Parsers
nodes.title: Transform Output Parsers
nodes.description: Parsers that can handle streaming input and transform it incrementally, useful for real-time processing of LLM outputs.

nodes.label: XMLOutputParser
nodes.title: XML Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses XML formatted strings from LLM outputs into a dictionary structure, with options for secure parsing.

nodes.label: DatetimeOutputParser
nodes.title: Datetime Output Parser
nodes.description: Converts LLM-generated strings into datetime objects based on a specified format.

nodes.label: EnumOutputParser
nodes.title: Enum Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output to match one of the predefined values in an enumeration.

nodes.label: OutputFixingParser
nodes.title: Output Fixing Parser
nodes.description: Wraps another parser and attempts to fix parsing errors by re-prompting the LLM with error details.

nodes.label: PandasDataFrameOutputParser
nodes.title: Pandas DataFrame Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output into operations or selections on a Pandas DataFrame, supporting various query types.

nodes.label: RetryOutputParser
nodes.title: Retry Output Parser
nodes.description: Similar to OutputFixingParser, this parser retries parsing by providing the original prompt and completion to an LLM for correction.

nodes.label: StructuredOutputParser
nodes.title: Structured Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output into a structured dictionary based on a list of defined response schemas.

nodes.label: YamlOutputParser
nodes.title: YAML Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses YAML formatted strings from LLM outputs into a Pydantic object, validating against a defined schema.

nodes.label: ConvoOutputParser
nodes.title: Conversational Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses conversational agent output into either an AgentAction (tool use) or AgentFinish (final answer).

nodes.label: ReActJsonSingleInputOutputParser
nodes.title: ReAct JSON Single Input Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses ReAct-style LLM outputs with a single tool input in JSON format, determining if an action or final answer is provided.

nodes.label: StructuredChatOutputParserWithRetries
nodes.title: Structured Chat Output Parser with Retries
nodes.description: An output parser for structured chat agents that includes retry logic to handle parsing errors.

nodes.label: StructuredQueryOutputParser
nodes.title: Structured Query Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output into a structured query object, including query string and filter directives.

groups.label: Core Parsers
groups.title: Core Output Parsers
groups.description: Fundamental classes and common utility parsers for structuring LLM outputs.

groups.label: Specialized Parsers
groups.title: Specialized Output Parsers
groups.description: Parsers tailored for specific data types or complex output structures, such as dates, enums, or dataframes.

groups.label: Robustness & Agent Parsers
groups.title: Robustness and Agent-Specific Parsers
groups.description: Parsers designed to improve robustness through error fixing and retries, and those specifically for agent interactions.
